reason: I would let my admin try the free 30, but a café goes through 30 receipts in a few days, and that is too short to know if the staff will keep sending properly or if she will just go back to her Excel. I am not starting another monthly payment for something we might drop after two weeks.
objection: My staff and I are not sure we will keep using it after the free part. Everyone already has their way, my admin has her spreadsheet, and when nobody is pushing it, it stops.
would_change_my_mind: If after the free documents my admin tells me she did not have to type anything on Monday and the staff kept sending without me reminding them, then $19 is nothing.
